title: Papers Relating to the Aboriginal Tribes of the Central Provinces
reuse_basis: Original 1866 edition is public domain by age. Cornell's digitization front matter says there are no known US copyright restrictions on use of the text. Four rendered vocabulary pages and attributed lexical facts are retained; the whole source PDF is only a temporary review cache.
source_lect: Kuri, or Muâsi, the historical column heading; classified here as a source-qualified Korku dialect on the basis of Hislop/Temple's Kuri/Muasi versus Gondi distinction, Pearson's Koorku/Muasi identification reported by Temple, Glottolog Korku alternate names, and Zide's identification of Hislop 1866 as early Korku data
scope: Complete main Kuri/Muasi vocabulary pp.1–43 (scan53–95), all five witnesses of comparative table scan109, and joint Kúr/Kól comparative prose Essay p.27 (scan47)
held_detail: Elliott comparison buffalo and star: damaged type prevents full secure headword, with provisional readings retained in per-cell audit.
visual_review: All464units accounted and manually reviewed; independent fresh20 passed0errors; essay prose and all13exactreuse cases independently verified.
overlap_policy: Exact form-and-gloss coincidences for Ti arm and Lai belly with later Stahl 2021 Korku material are independent historical attestations and retained; Gondi/Keikadi same-print forms are column controls, not duplicate Kuri records.
provenance_policy: Hislop's manuscript vocabulary was rearranged by Temple for print; stable entry keys are printed page plus prompt ordinal, not asserted manuscript sequence. Temple notes that some Gondi blanks were later supplemented at Nagpur, not the Kuri column. Hislop's exact Kuri elicitation location and speaker are unstated, so dialect coordinates are blank.
transcription_policy: Source-preserving lowercase profile with house w→v orthography; acute, macron, hyphens and uncertain raised grave retained; no unsupported phonemic conversion.
full_build: Deferred: user explicitly prohibits full builds and database construction.
scope_controls: Other language columns, Gondi supplement, connected Gondi songs, appendix ethnography and names without explicit Korku-language attribution excluded.
review_note: Full source stage installed; compiled/full-suite/browser gates deferred under explicit user instruction. Two specific damaged source readings remain accounted holds.
